builds.name: Reference: Contact fighter
builds.goal: Reference for Lee Sin: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A mobile skirmisher who interleaves attacks for Energy and uses ally dashes and kicks to choose fight geometry. Interleave attacks for energy and passive cadence. Record ally/ward access and kick geometry; lethality burst must justify the survival and utility lost. Stridebreaker access and conditional Sundered Sky sustain may buy time for repeated kit damage.
builds.summary: Stridebreaker access and conditional Sundered Sky sustain may buy time for repeated kit damage.
testPlan: Kit question for Lee Sin: Interleave attacks for energy and passive cadence. Record ally/ward access and kick geometry; lethality burst must justify the survival and utility lost.

Start with the early core (Stridebreaker, then Sundered Sky) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Resource: Energy. Do not treat mana regeneration as Energy recovery; Nimbus replaces Manaflow when that Sorcery row is used.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Stridebreaker access and conditional Sundered Sky sustain may buy time for repeated kit damage. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Sonic Wave: Lee Sin projects a discordant wave of sound to locate his enemies, dealing physical damage to the first enemy it encounters. If Sonic Wave hits, Lee Sin can cast Resonating Strike for the next 3 seconds.
Resonating Strike: Lee Sin dashes to the enemy hit by Sonic Wave, dealing physical damage based on the target's missing Health. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
failureConditions: Physical pressure or sustained contact must justify these purchases; MR and healing slots are matchup dependent.

Higher dummy damage is offset by fewer landed actions, deaths before the useful window, or worse ally utility.
tradeoffs: Physical pressure or sustained contact must justify these purchases; MR and healing slots are matchup dependent.
Full cost 16,800 gold; delayed items, resource starvation and the two-item spike must be judged separately.
The reference is a research control, not a claim of the current highest-win-rate build.
buyOrder: Stridebreaker, then Sundered Sky. Adapt component timing to lane/jungle pressure; do not blindly follow the displayed six-item order.
Keep appropriate boots while building the early core; swap boots only when the measured matchup justifies it.
Sterak's Gage, Death's Dance, Spirit Visage are later or conditional slots; do not postpone necessary protection for a six-item ceiling.
Resource: Energy. Do not treat mana regeneration as Energy recovery; Nimbus replaces Manaflow when that Sorcery row is used.

builds.name: Safeguard AP escort
builds.summary: Test the 0.8 AP ally shield while retaining peel access.
builds.goal: Test the 0.8 AP ally shield while retaining peel access.
builds.hypothesis: Safeguard shields both Lee Sin and a champion ally for two seconds with 0.8 AP scaling; ward casts do not grant the documented champion shield. Helia converts actual damage into allied healing through the shield and Staff/Ardent buff both after protection. Flurry supplies two energy-restoring attacks between casts; E slow and R knockback defend the shield recipient.
testPlan: Required state: Need a champion dash target, enough energy and safe attacks to restore it.
Measure allied shield and Helia heal with champion casts versus ward casts, then record energy after weaving.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Low AD undermines damage threats; a ward escape does not deliver the promised allied shield.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Mana regen on support items is a wasted stat, not energy regeneration; no mana pool item is included.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Echoes of Helia, Staff of Flowing Water, Ardent Censer, Spirit Visage, Locket of the Iron Solari, Ionian Boots of Lucidity. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

builds.name: Kick-through health bruiser
builds.summary: Use a high-health frontliner as a physical projectile.
builds.goal: Use a high-health frontliner as a physical projectile.
builds.hypothesis: Dragon's Rage has 2 AD statFormula=2 physical damage; collision victims additionally take 12-18% of the kicked target's bonus health. Bloodmail/Shojin improve AD-linked spell pressure, Cleaver supports physical damage, and Sundered Sky rewards the Flurry weave. Iron Will's four-second omnivamp helps only when actual damage lands after the kick rather than during a failed displacement.
testPlan: Required state: Need an aligned enemy frontliner and carry behind it, with Q mark for access.
Compare primary versus collision damage against targets with different bonus health and identical armor.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: A bad angle saves the opponent; the target can reposition before Lee commits.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: The collision health bonus comes from the kicked enemy, not Lee Sin's purchased health.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Overlord's Bloodmail, Spear of Shojin, Sundered Sky, Black Cleaver, Sterak's Gage, Mercury's Treads. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
